name: Seek Redemption!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Council of the Forest has news that you aided Zenn Foulhoof. The satyr is an enemy of the forest. As a friend, you should know better than to defile the forest by killing Nature's creatures.

You must redeem yourself in the eyes of the Council if you wish to remain a friend of Teldrassil.

Teach Foulhoof a lesson and you shall be redeemed. Fel Cones are corrupted seeds that fall from the trees. They billow with green smoke.

Give some to Foulhoof. He'll think you have brought him a harmless snack.
narrative.objectives: Collect 3 Fel Cones and give them to Zenn Foulhoof outside of Dolanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, what a sweet friend! I knew you would come in handy!
narrative.requestItemsText: What do you have for me, adventurer? A lovely snack I presume?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 5 to 7, 1,075 XP in all.

quests.name: Zenn's Bidding
quests.objectiveText: Bring Zenn Foulhoof outside of Dolanaar 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.
